　ここからネロまで、距離にして十メートルあるかないかだ。
　その距離をネロに気付かれずに接近するためには、もっと決定的な隙が必要だ。
lines.label: s100
lines.maoEnglish:
Not yet.
It is still too soon—barely ten meters separate me from Nrvnqsr.
To cross that distance without being noticed, I need a far more decisive opening.

とすると、アレはただの塵か」

“—! Shiki, run!”

ぬめり、と足元が沈む。
　あれほど確かだった地面が、ぬかるみのようになっている。
「あ――――――」
　足元は、真っ黒い何かに満ちていた。
　ぐらりと体が倒れる。
　黒い水たまりに沈んだ俺の足首は、そこから先がなかった。
lines.label: s100
lines.maoEnglish:
The ground turns slick and sinks beneath my feet.
What had been solid earth a moment ago has become a quagmire.
“Ah————”
Something utterly black covers the ground around me.
My body pitches sideways.
The ankle submerged in that black pool ends at the surface; there is nothing below it.

　チャンスはこの一瞬だけ。
　ナイフを構えて、身を低くして。
　一息で、俺はネロへと走り出した。
lines.label: s101

Nrvnqsr has eyes only for Arcueid.
This instant is my one chance.
Knife at the ready, I crouch low.
I burst into a sprint toward him.

ネロは全神経をアルクェイドに向けている。
　無関係である自分にもわかるぐらいに、ネロは前しか見ていない。
　背後から走りこんでくる俺に、あと数秒で解体されるなんて夢にも思っていない、無防備すぎるその背中。
―――行ける。
　直感。
　間違いなく、このまま殺せる。
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
Every nerve in Nrvnqsr’s body is fixed on Arcueid.
Even I, an outsider, can tell that he sees nothing but what lies ahead.
His back is naked to me, utterly unsuspecting that in a few more seconds I’ll be upon him, carving him apart.
―――I can do this.
Instinct.
If I keep going, I can kill him for certain.

Arcueid narrows her eyes almost imperceptibly, then walks unsteadily toward Nrvnqsr.

“Haaah—haaah—haaah.”
Why?
Arcueid sounds as though she is suffering even more than Nrvnqsr, whose body has been torn in half.

　呼吸を整えながら、アルクェイドはゆっくりとネロへと近づいていく。
lines.label: s101

――――Something is wrong.
A terrible certainty of disaster settles over me.
“Haaah—haah.”
Slowly mastering her breath, Arcueid continues toward Nrvnqsr.

lines.japanese:
「だが私とて、もとより十や二十程度の私で貴様を仕留めようなどとは思っていない」
「―――強がりはそこまでよ。
あなたが使役する使い魔では何匹かかろうとわたしを殺せないし、その半身もすでに断った。
どうやってもあなたに勝ち目なんかない」
「フン―――私の使い魔はことごとく殺されたがね。
一つ、貴様は思い違いをしているようだ」
「――――？」
「私は使い魔など持っていないし、使役などもしていない。
今おまえの相手をしたのは、あくまで私自身なのだよ。
　……破損した肉体を他の生物で補おう、などとする他の雑種どもと同一視されるのは不愉快だ」
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yet neither did I imagine that a mere ten or twenty of me would suffice to destroy you.”
“Enough bravado. No matter how many familiars you send, they cannot kill me, and I have already severed half your body. You have no chance of winning.”
“Hmph. My familiars were slaughtered to the last, but you are mistaken about one thing.”
“……?”
“I possess no familiars, nor do I command any. Every creature that fought you was nothing other than myself.
Do not insult me by confusing me with those mongrels who patch their damaged flesh with the bodies of other creatures.”

「本来の貴様ならば一目で気がついたろうに。
その金色の魔眼をこらしてよく見るがいい。
視えるだろう？
　我が体内に内包された、六百六十六素の“ケモノ”たちの混沌が―――」
　びゅるん、と。
　視界のはじっこで、何かが動いた。
「あ―――――」
　アルクェイドの背後。
　たったいまアルクェイドに裂かれ、地面に朽ち倒れたネロの半身が震えている。
　ぶるん、と大きな塊になって、アルクェイドへと鎌首をもたげて―――。
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
“In your true state, you would have known at a glance. Strain those golden Mystic Eyes and look closely. You can see it, can you not? The chaos of the ‘beasts’ contained within me—the six hundred sixty-six factors.”
Something lashes past.
I catch the movement at the edge of my vision.
“Ah…”
Behind Arcueid.
The half of Nrvnqsr she tore away—the ruined mass sprawled on the earth—is trembling.
It swells into one great lump and rears over her like a snake preparing to strike.

　今の俺と同じように、正確には俺の何百倍という質量に圧迫されて、アルクェイドは地面にくぎ付けにされてしまった。
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
“No—”
The snakes coil around Arcueid, then melt back into the black torrent they came from.
Like me—but pinned beneath hundreds of times the weight—Arcueid is nailed to the ground.

lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:

“Futile. You, of all beings, should understand what that substance is, Princess of the True Ancestors.”
“……!”
Pain—and shock—show on Arcueid’s face.
Still only half a body, Nrvnqsr raises his voice in a triumphant roar.

lines.japanese:
「―――思慮のあるものは獣の数字をとくがいい。
それは人間を表す数字、すなわち６６６である―――くく、我が体内の混沌は気にいったか、アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド」
「正気なの、あなた……！？
　ヒトの体に……ヒトの形なんていう狭量で密閉された空間に、三百以上の数の因子を圧縮して内包してるなんて、これじゃまるで―――」
「いかにも。
これでは原初の海と何らかわりはない。
　私はな、他の動物どもを我が肉体としているのではない。
『動物』という因子を肉体とし、混濁させているのみだ」
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
“Let those with wisdom decipher the number of the beast: it is the number of man, six hundred sixty-six. Heh—does the chaos within me please you, Arcueid Brunestud?”
“Are you insane?! Compressing more than three hundred factors inside a human body—inside something as cramped and sealed as the human form—this is almost—”
“Precisely. It differs in no respect from the primordial sea.
I do not make other animals into my flesh. I make flesh of the factor called ‘animal,’ and mingle those factors together.”

"Are you sane……!?
A human body… having more than three hundred factors compressed in something as small and closed-in as a human shape, this is just like----"
"Indeed, no different from the Primordial Sea.

lines.japanese:
「私に使い魔などいない。
いるのは六百六十六ものケモノたち―――それと同等の数を持つ命たちだ。
　この身の半身を断とうが、この首を潰そうが意味はない。
私は一にして６６６。
私を滅ぼすつもりであるのならば、一瞬にして六百六十六の命を滅ぼすつもりでなくてはな」
「……うそ……カオス……混沌って、そういう意味……！？」
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
“I have no familiars. What I contain are six hundred sixty-six beasts—and as many lives.
Sever half this body, crush this head; it signifies nothing. I am one, and I am six hundred sixty-six. To destroy me, you must be prepared to extinguish six hundred sixty-six lives in a single instant.”
“No—Chaos, is that what your name means?!”
lines.mao_english:
“I have no familiars. What I contain are six hundred sixty-six beasts—and as many lives.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"I have no such things as familiars.
What exists are 666 beasts----and lives equal to that number.
Ripping my body in half or crushing my head is meaningless.
I am one and 666.
If you wish to destroy me, you need to destroy 666 lives at once."
"…… This can't be…… this is what Chaos means……!?"
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「無論だ。
―――よって、我が分身たちはその存在が一定しない。
　我が領地であるこの肉体から外界に放たれた時、初めて何らかの『種』としてカタチをなす。
　もとよりカタチのないモノたちだ。
外で殺されたところで、私の中に戻れば再び混沌の一つとして蘇生する。
　……もっとも、外に出る時に何になるのかは私自身にも予測がつかぬがね。
この乱れた系統樹を把握し、操作する事が私の永遠の命題だよ」
　半身しかない吸血鬼は、誇らしげに、くぐもった笑い声をあげる。
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
“Naturally. My other selves therefore possess no fixed existence.
Only when released from the domain of this body into the outer world do they assume the form of a particular species.
They are formless by nature. Slay them outside, and once they return to me they revive as elements of the chaos.
Though even I cannot predict what each will become when it emerges. To comprehend and command this disordered tree of life is my eternal pursuit.”
The half-bodied vampire gives a muffled chuckle, rich with pride.

lines.mirrorMoon:

----So my alter selves have no concrete existence.
When released from this body which is my territory, they will take form as some kind of 'species' for the first time.
They have no form of their own from the beginning.
You can kill them outside of me, but once they return, they regenerate as a part of my chaos.
…… Though, even I cannot predict what they will become once they emerge.
Understanding and controlling this disordered dendrogram is my eternal thesis."
The vampire with only half a body gives a boasting, muffled laugh.

「そんなの不可能だわ……！
　魂を――――何の着色もすんでいない存在概念なんかを内包したら、あなた自身が消えてしまう……！」
「いかにも。
故に、ここにいるのは個人ではない。
すでにネロなどという人格は存在せん。
我らは個体ではなく限りなく群体に近い。
　……たしかに。
そうなった生命になど存在の意義はない。
永久機関ともいえる生命種ならばすでに深海に棲息している。
この身もいずれ、彼らと同じように知性を失いただの『標本』になりさがろう」
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
“That’s impossible! If you contain souls—pure concepts of existence that have yet to take on any nature—you yourself will disappear!”
“Indeed. Thus, the being before you is no individual. The personality called Nrvnqsr no longer exists. We are not an individual organism, but something infinitely close to a collective.
And yes. A life reduced to that state has no meaning. Life-forms that might be called perpetual-motion machines already dwell in the deepest seas. In time, this body too will lose its intellect and degenerate into nothing more than a specimen.”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"That's impossible……!
To take in souls----if you encapsulate uncolored conceptualized existences, you yourself will disappear……!"
"Indeed.
That is why this is not a single person here.
The personality of Nrvnqsr already does not exist.
We are not a single body, but closer to a limitless collective.
…… Certainly, there is no meaning of existence in such a life.
There are already life forms in the deep ocean which can be termed eternal systems.
This body will lose its intelligence and become a mere 'specimen' just like them someday."

lines.japanese:
「だが、素晴らしいとは思わないか。
　私の中には『何になるか解らないもの』が渦巻いている。
それは原初のこの世界そのものともいえる小世界だ。
　どのような生き物が生まれるか予測がつかない混沌とした空間。
　現存するこの星の系統樹と同じでありながら、なお劇的な変化の可能性を持つ混沌の闇。
　その果てになにが待つのか、私は私が消える前に知りたい。
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
“But is it not magnificent?
Things with no predetermined form whirl within me. A miniature world, like this world at its birth.
A chaotic realm where no one can foresee what living thing will arise.
A darkness sharing the lineage of every creature now upon this planet, yet still pregnant with the possibility of dramatic change.
I wish to know what waits at its end before the last of me disappears.”

I wish to know what lies at its culmination before I disappear."

lines.maoEnglish:

The black liquid heaves and sucks around her.
Now barely half her face remains visible.

lines.japanese:
「……以上だ。
いかな貴様といえど、その檻からは抜けられぬ。
我が分身のうち五百もの結束で練り上げた“創世の土”。
　たとえ貴様が万全であったとしても、それを破壊することは叶わぬ。

　半身しかないネロは、ゆっくりとアルクェイドへと近寄っていく。
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
“That concludes the lesson. Not even you can escape that cage. It is the Soil of Genesis, kneaded from the united substance of five hundred of my other selves.
Even at the height of your power, you could not destroy it. To do so would be to destroy an entire continent.”
Reduced to half a body, Nrvnqsr advances slowly toward Arcueid.

“Since your advent, how many of my brethren have you buried, and how many of my forebears sought to destroy you only to have that doom visited upon themselves?
――――But it ends here.
Nrvnqsr Chaos has achieved what none before him could.”

lines.maoEnglish:
“Nrvnqsr… Who taught you this Reality Marble?”
“Who else? Your sworn enemy, the Serpent, came to instruct me of his own accord. Not his present incarnation, naturally. Before you killed him in Paris, he left me the means to create this cage.”
“……”
Arcueid makes no sound.
The black slime has already swallowed her mouth.

lines.japanese:
「しかし“蛇”も無惨なものよ。
吸血種と成る前は教会の司祭だった男が、貴様のような死神に狙われたばかりに生き延びられんとは。
　ヤツが生きておれば、我が体内の混沌も今ごろは法則性が作られていただろう。
……それほどの魔道の冴えを持ちながら発揮できずに滅ぼされるなど、さぞ無念であったろうよ」
lines.label: s101
lines.maoEnglish:
“How wretched the Serpent’s fate. Before he joined the vampiric species he was a priest of the Church, yet once a god of death such as you marked him, he could not survive.
Had he lived, the chaos within me would by now possess its own laws. To command such brilliance in the arcane arts and be destroyed before he could bring it to fruition—his regret must have been profound.”
lines.mao_english:
“How wretched the Serpent’s fate. Before he joined the vampiric species he was a priest of the Church, yet once a god of death such as you marked him, he could not survive.
Had he lived, the chaos within me would by now possess its own laws. To command such brilliance in the arcane arts and be destroyed before he could bring it to fruition—his regret must have been profound.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"But 'The Serpent' is also a tragedy.
What was once a priest of The Church can't live on just because a Goddess of Death like yourself is chasing after him.
If he had lived, he might have devised a means to control the chaos in my body.
…… It certainly must have been regretful not being able to fully utilize such a clear heresy before getting destroyed."

「―――このまま私の一人になってもらうぞ、アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド。

“Now you will become one of me, Arcueid Brunestud.
Absorbing a consciousness as mighty as yours will be arduous, but once it is done, I shall stand at the summit of all vampiric species. A measure of pain will only sweeten the celebration of my birth.
Then even the accursed killers of the Burial Agency will inspire no fear. That mold-ridden Church—and every soul connected to it—I shall exterminate them all.”

“Ghk!”

lines.japanese:
「あははははははははは！」
　裂帛の気合のかわりに、白痴のごとき笑い声をあげた。
　おかしい。
　おかしくて、笑いがとまらない。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ahahahahahahaha!”
Instead of a warrior’s cry, I let out the mindless laughter of an idiot.
It was funny.
So funny I couldn’t stop laughing.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:

Strangely, I can't stop laughing.
lines.mirror_moon:

　脳髄が痛い。
　体じゅうの神経血管細胞血液、全てがどうかしちまった。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
Slash, slash, slash, slash, slash—the beasts die one after another.
My brain is in agony.
Every nerve, every vein, every cell, every drop of blood in my body has gone wrong.

Slice.
Slice.

―――黒いドームはなくなった。
　この身をついばんでいた雑種どものうち七十匹ばかりを、とりあえずブチ殺した。
「な―――――に？」
　ネロの声が聞こえる。
　さあ―――立ちあがらないと、これ以上は殺せない。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
―――The black dome was gone.
Of the mongrels pecking at this body, I had slaughtered seventy or so—for now.
“Wha—at?”
I hear Nrvnqsr’s voice.
Now—if I don’t stand, I won’t be able to kill any more of them.

「貴様―――なにを」
「―――ああ、おまえの気持ちはよくわかったよ、吸血鬼」
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
I stand.
“…”
No problem.
There isn’t a single uninjured place on my body, but I should still be able to move for a while.
“You—what have you done?”
“Ah—I understand exactly how you feel now, vampire.”

　似てる―――アルクェイドを殺した時と同じで、まともに呼吸ができやしない。
　イッちまいそうなほどの頭痛と熱と引き換えに、
　吐き気がするほど、
　セカイに死が満ちている―――。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
My brain feels on fire.
It’s like when I killed Arcueid—I can’t even breathe properly.
In exchange for a headache and heat fierce enough to make me come,
with sickening clarity,
death floods the world.

―――殺しあおうぜ、ネロ・カオス……！」
　あれだけ硬かった右手が自由に動く。
　くるん、とナイフをまわして逆手に構えて、ネロに向かって走り出した。
lines.label: s104

“Fine. Let’s kill each other, Nrvnqsr Chaos…!”
The right hand that had been locked so rigid moves freely.
I twirl the knife, reverse it into an underhand grip, and charge Nrvnqsr.

ネロの体から、一際大きいケモノが現れる。
　ようやくアルクェイドに出していた大物を出してきてくれたらしい。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:

At last, he has brought out one of the monsters he used against Arcueid.
lines.mao_english:

At last, he has brought out one of the monsters he used against Arcueid.

「――――――」
　だが、あまり長くは保たなかった。
　どんなに巨大で迅速で強暴でも、連中は基本的に直接触れなければ俺を殺せない。
　直接こちらに触れようとするのなら。
　その触れようとする部分を切断する。
　結局は、黒犬もライオンもトラもあまり変わらなかった。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
It didn’t last long.
However huge, fast, or savage they might be.
The beasts can’t kill me without touching me.
And if they reach out to touch me, I cut away whatever reaches.
In the end, the black dog, the lion, and the tiger are all much the same.
lines.mao_english:
“…”

lines.mirrorMoon:

If they try to touch me,
I slice whatever part tries.
In the end, it made no difference whether it was a black dog, a lion or a tiger.

二匹の大物が倒れて、黒い水に変わっていく。
　ネロまでは――まだいくらか距離が開いているか。
「―――馬鹿な。
姫君でさえ消滅させられなかった私たちが―――ことごとく、無に帰している」
　なにか、言ってる。
「―――不理解だ。
貴様、何をした」
　ネロの体を凝視する。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
The two great beasts collapse and dissolve into black water.
Nrvnqsr is still some distance away.
“Impossible. Even the princess could not annihilate us—yet every one of us is being reduced to nothing.”
He’s saying something.
“I do not understand. What have you done?”
I stare into Nrvnqsr’s body.

　―――生き残りたいのなら。
　アイツを殺したいのなら、アレを、全て殺さなければいけない。
lines.label: s104

―――If I want to survive.
If I want to kill him, I have to kill every last one.
lines.mao_english:

If I want to kill him, I have to kill every last one.

lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「…………」
　流石にそれは不可能だろう。
　それでも―――このままじゃ終われない。
　黒い粘液に飲まれたアルクェイド。
　殺されてしまった何百という人たち。
―――そして、殺されかけたこの体。
「……………！」
　ギリ、と歯を噛んだ。
　恨み言を口にする余裕はない。
　あいにく動くだけで精一杯なんだ。
ネロの口上に付き合っている余裕はない。

―――否
　そんな余裕があるのなら、一秒でも早く―――
「―――よかろう。
おまえを、我が障害と認識する」

―――このケモノ臭い化け物の息の根を止めたほうが、幾分はましだろう。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
That is surely impossible.
Even so—I can’t let it end here.
Arcueid, swallowed by the black slime.
The hundreds of people he killed.
―――And this body, nearly killed along with them.
“…!”
My teeth grind together.
I don’t have breath to spare on curses.
Unfortunately, moving at all is taking everything I have. I can’t waste time listening to Nrvnqsr’s speeches.
―――No
If I had breath to spare, I would rather use it to―――
“—Very well. I acknowledge you as an obstacle.”
―――stop this monster reeking of beasts from drawing another.

ごっ、と黒いコートが大きくはだけた。
　品のないケモノの臭い。
　危機感は、今までの比ではない。
　コートの中から、どこか、子供のころに一度は見た覚えがあるようなケモノが飛び出してくる。
　額に角のある馬だの、翼の生えた大きなトカゲだの。
　それらは、たしかに厄介だった。
　とても簡単には殺せない。
　なにしろ『死に易い部分』がとても少ない。
　だから―――よけい、真剣になる。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
With a heavy rush, the black coat flares wide.
A rank, bestial stench rolls out.
The danger is beyond anything I have felt until now.
Beasts burst from the coat, creatures I seem to remember seeing once in childhood.
A horse with a horn in its brow, a huge lizard with wings.
They are troublesome, certainly.
They won’t die easily.
There are too few places on them where death comes readily.
And so—I grow all the more intent.

lines.mirrorMoon:
----killing this beast-smelling monster would be far better.

The vile stench of beasts.

Those are troublesome.
It's not simple to kill them,
because they have very few "parts vulnerable to death".
So---I get more serious.

　体中のあらゆるものが、あの障害を排除するために連結していく。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
Perhaps it was speaking the word kill aloud.
The blood moving through me hurts.
My nerves grind against themselves.
Everything in my body begins linking together for the sole purpose of eliminating that obstacle.

　トカゲは、背中から右下腹部にかけて切り取った。
「――――あり得ん」
　障害の声が聞こえる。
　あいにく、こっちはもうまともに視界が働かない。

「おのれ―――なぜ私が、たかだか人間風情に渾身でかからねばならぬのだ―――！」
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
I split the horned horse in two, horn and all.
I cut through the lizard from its back to the lower right side of its belly.
“—Impossible.”
The obstacle’s voice reaches me.
My vision no longer works properly.
All I can see are black points and lines.
“Damn you—why must I exert my full strength against a mere human?!”

“—I will kill you. Know this: the phylogenetic tree within me holds life-forms beyond the limits of your kind—”

All I can see are their bizarre silhouettes and their "death".

lines.japanese:
指先が冷たい。
　血を流しすぎたのか、体中が冷えきっている。
　それでも―――まだ体は悲鳴をあげてない。
　そんな余力があるのなら、一秒でも早くアイツを殺せと命令してくる。
―――背骨がいたい。
　　　体がさむい。
　　　指先が凍てついていく。
　　　なのに、脳髄だけが火のように熱く。
lines.label: s104

My fingertips are cold.
I must have lost too much blood; the chill has soaked through my whole body.
Yet my body still refuses to scream.
If it has strength left for that, it orders me to use it to kill him one second sooner.
―――My spine hurts.
My body is cold.
My fingertips are freezing.
And still my brain alone burns like fire.

蜘蛛とも蟹とも取れないケモノは次々とネロの体から這い出てくる。
　ネロまではあともう少し。
　ヤツの近づくためには、この生き物たちは邪魔だった。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
More beasts, neither quite spider nor crab, crawl from Nrvnqsr’s body.
I’m almost close enough to reach him.
These creatures are in my way.
lines.mao_english:

lines.japanese:
とりあえず三匹。
　出てきた分の邪魔者は、ことごとく殺した。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
Three of them, for now.
I kill every obstacle that has emerged.
lines.mao_english:

lines.japanese:
「――――有り得ん」
　ネロは眩暈でもおこしたように、よろりと後ずさる。
「―――私のあらゆる殺害方法が殺されるなど、そのような事実が有り得るはずがない……！
　私たちは不死身だ。
　私が存命しているかぎり死しても混沌となりて我に戻り転輪す不死のケモノたちが―――なぜ、貴様に刺されただけで、元の無に戻ってしまうのだ―――！」
　叫んでいる敵に歩み寄る。
　ネロは後ろに引こうとして、かろうじて、後退することを押しとめた。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
“—Impossible.”
Nrvnqsr staggers backward as if overcome by vertigo.
“It cannot be—every means by which I kill, itself killed…!
We are immortal.
So long as I live, my undying beasts return to chaos when slain, flow back into me, and turn upon the wheel once more—so why does a mere wound from you return them to the nothing from which they came?!”
I walk toward the shouting enemy.
Nrvnqsr starts to shrink away, then barely manages to arrest his retreat.

Nrvnqsr starts to shrink away, then barely manages to arrest his retreat.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----Impossible."
As if dizzy, Nrvnqsr moves back.
"----There is no way someone can destroy all my killing beasts.
Such a fact is impossible……!
We are immortal.
As long as I live, the immortal beasts return to chaos and are reborn----so then, why do they return to the original nothingness after only being stabbed by you----!?"
I walk towards my screaming enemy.
Nrvnqsr tries to pull back in retreat, but stops himself.

「―――無様」
　機械のようだった目に、赤い憎しみの感情が、ようやく燈った。
　ヤツのココロは理解できる。
―――おそらく。
　殺人鬼としてのネロは己に撤退を命じている。
　しかし吸血鬼としてのヤツは、自らがただの人間に敗退することを認めない。
　理解しない。
　撤退することさえ許さない。
　だから、それ以上後退することを可能としない。
　その精神、自身が無力だと悟るも認めぬ頑なさ。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
“—Pathetic.”
At last, red hatred kindles in eyes that had been as lifeless as a machine’s.
I understand what is happening inside him.
―――Probably.
The killer in Nrvnqsr orders him to retreat.
The vampire in him refuses to accept defeat at the hands of a mere human.
It will not comprehend it.
It will not permit even a retreat.
And so it makes another backward step impossible.
That is his spirit: an obstinacy that recognizes its own powerlessness and still refuses to admit it.

lines.japanese:
さらに一歩。
　これで、あとは跳びかかればナイフでヤツの体を裂けるところにきた。
「―――否、断じて否―――！
　我が名はネロ、朽ちずうごめく吸血種の中において、なお不死身と称された混沌だ！
　それがこのような無様を見せるなぞ、断じてありえぬ……！」
―――ネロの体が、カタチをもっていく。
　今まで闇でしかなかった体は、明らかに個として化肉していく。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
One more step.
Now a single leap will bring him within reach of my knife.
“―――No, absolutely not―――!
My name is Nrvnqsr, chaos itself, called immortal even among the deathless, crawling species of vampires! That I should display such disgrace is beyond all possibility……!”
―――Nrvnqsr’s body takes shape.
What had been nothing but darkness takes on the unmistakable flesh of an individual body.

"----No, never----!
My name is Nrvnqsr, the immortal called Chaos of the undecaying vampire race!
It is not possible for me to look this unsightly……!"
----His body starts to form a shape.
The body which was only darkness begins to transform.

I transcended death long ago—!”

Not his beasts.
He has compressed every creature remaining within him to its utmost limit, made himself the supreme beast, and come to stop my heart.

　触れればその場で首を粉砕されかねない腕が伸びてくる。

An arm reaches for me that could shatter my neck the instant it touches.
I slip past it and sever the line on his arm as we cross.

I can’t stop shaking.

　切られた腕を見て、ネロは愕然としている。
「なんなのだ、これは―――！
　何故――何故切られた個所が再生しない！？
　こんなたわけた話があるものか……！
　アレは魔術師でもなければ埋葬者でもないというのに、何故、ただ切られただけで私が滅びねばならんのだ―――！？」
「―――馬鹿ね。
そんなつまらない体面を気にしてると殺されるわよ、ネロ・カオス」
　ネロの傍らから、聞きなれた声がした。

“—What is this?”
Nrvnqsr stares in shock at his severed arm.
“What is this?! Why—why will the wound not regenerate? Such absurdity cannot exist…! That thing is neither mage nor Burial Agent, so why must I perish merely because he cut me?!”
“You fool. Keep worrying about such petty matters of pride and he’ll kill you, Nrvnqsr Chaos.”
A familiar voice comes from beside him.

“Oh yes, there was one thing I forgot to mention, Nrvnqsr.”
Before he can leap, her voice drifts through the air like wind.
“It may be rather late to tell you now. But he has already killed me once.”
“Wha—at?”
This time, truly.
Nrvnqsr’s astonishment makes him lose all command of himself.

その間隙。
　忘我するヤツの思考が、それこそ呪いのように、俺の意識に流れてくる。

His disordered thoughts pour into my consciousness like a curse.

―――それは、悪夢か。
　アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッドを殺す？
　この、不死身などという言葉さえ生ぬるい怪物を、あの人間は殺したというのか？
　いや、それこそ否だ。
　だがもし。
仮釈、それが真実だとするならば。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
―――Is this a nightmare?
Kill Arcueid Brunestud?
That human killed a monster for whom even the word immortal is woefully inadequate?
No, that above all is impossible.
But suppose. Suppose it were true…

―――果たして。
　思いあがっていたのは、一体どちらだったのか。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
―――Then.
Which of us had truly been blinded by arrogance?
lines.mao_english:
―――Then.
Which of us had truly been blinded by arrogance?
lines.mirrorMoon:

just which one of us was the pretentious one?

just which one of us was the pretentious one?

lines.japanese:
「そういうコト。
思いあがっていたのはあなたのほうだったみたいね、ネロ・カオス」
「く――――ふふ、はははははははは！」
　憎悪と混乱の果てに。
　ネロ・カオスは、心底愉快そうに、声をあげて嗤った。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. It seems you were the arrogant one after all, Nrvnqsr Chaos.”
“Kh—heh, hahahahahaha!”
At the farthest limit of hatred and confusion.
Nrvnqsr Chaos throws back his head and laughs as though nothing in the world had ever delighted him more.

「そうか、私を殺すのか、人間――――！」
―――ケモノが吠える。
　　　片腕で、
　　　一直線に俺の心臓を貫こうと疾走してくる。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
―――I can’t wait any longer.
I break into a run toward the motionless target.
“So—you mean to kill me, human?!”
―――The beast roars.
With one arm extended, he charges straight at my heart,
intent on piercing it through.

　余分なものがない、
　この俺を殺そうとするだけの、
　綺麗すぎる活動だった。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
The charge is flawless in its speed,
simple,
stripped of everything superfluous,
devoted solely to killing me—
an action too pure to be anything but beautiful.

lines.japanese:
「―――――」
　伸ばされた腕を切る。
　ヤツの体には、何百という『死の点』が存在する。
　けれど、そんなモノより。
　ヤツの深いところ、中心の最中にある『極点』が、確かに視えた。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
I cut the outstretched arm.
Hundreds of Points of Death exist throughout his body.
More deeply than any of them.
At the very heart of him, I can see one absolute point.
lines.mao_english:
“…”

At the very heart of him, I can see one absolute point.
lines.mirrorMoon:

I slice his outstretched arm.
Hundreds of "points of death" are on his body.
But, more than that,
deep inside of him, in his very center, I can see his "Ultimate Point".

　俺が殺すのは、ネロ・カオスという『存在』のみだ。
　だから、ネロを殺すのではない。
　この男が内包したと言う、その混沌。
　一つの世界を抹殺する――――――
lines.label: s104

――――It doesn’t matter how many hundreds of lives he possesses.
The only thing I mean to kill is the being known as Nrvnqsr Chaos.
I am not killing Nrvnqsr.
What I am killing is the chaos this man claims to contain.
I will annihilate an entire world――――――

　トン、という軽い音。
――――ナイフは、確実にヤツの最中を貫通する。
　にやりと口の端をつりあげて、吸血鬼は声も無く笑った。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
We collide head-on.
A soft tap.
――――The knife passes unerringly through his center.
One corner of the vampire’s mouth curls upward in a soundless laugh.
lines.mao_english:

Twisting his lips in a grin, the vampire laughs voicelessly.

lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish: “It cannot be.”
lines.mao_english: “It cannot be.”
lines.mirrorMoon: "This can't be."
lines.mirror_moon: "This can't be."

lines.japanese:
じくり、と。
　指先からバラバラと一つ一つに崩れていく黒い黒いケモノの躯。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
Slowly, inexorably.
The black, black carcass of the beast crumbles apart piece by piece, beginning at the fingertips.
lines.mao_english:
Slowly, inexorably.

lines.mirrorMoon:

lines.japanese: 「―――――おまえが、私の死か」
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish: “—So you are my death.”
lines.mao_english: “—So you are my death.”
lines.mirrorMoon: "------You… are my death?"
lines.mirror_moon: "------You… are my death?"

lines.japanese:
体温が、急速に霧散していく。
　終わりは幕を引くように一瞬だった。
　この一撃のもと。
　残る五百六十の獣とともに、ネロ・カオスは死滅した。
lines.label: s104
lines.maoEnglish:
The warmth drains swiftly from his body.
The end comes in an instant, like the fall of a curtain.
With this single blow.
Nrvnqsr Chaos perishes together with the five hundred and sixty beasts that remained.
lines.mao_english:

Nrvnqsr Chaos perishes together with the five hundred and sixty beasts that remained.
lines.mirrorMoon:

The end is instantaneous like a dropping curtain.
With this one attack,
along with the remaining 560 beasts, Nrvnqsr Chaos is annihilated.

lines.japanese:
「つか―――れた」
　がくん、と地面に崩れ落ちる。
　尻餅をついて、両手で倒れようとする体を支える。
lines.label: s105
lines.maoEnglish:
“I’m―――beat”
My legs gave way and I crumpled to the ground.
I landed hard on my backside, catching my collapsing body with both hands.
lines.mao_english:
“I’m―――beat”

I landed hard on my backside, catching my collapsing body with both hands.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"I'm---exhausted…"
I collapse onto the ground.
I fall on my rear and try to keep my body up with my hands.
lines.mirror_moon:
"I'm---exhausted…"
I collapse onto the ground.
I fall on my rear and try to keep my body up with my hands.

lines.japanese:
「―――さむ」
　とにかく寒い。
　痛みはとうに麻痺していて、むしろ心地いい。
　体のふしぶしには犬の歯形だの鳥のくちばしがつけたえぐり傷だの、盛大にやられたもんだ。
―――まあ、間違いなく。
このまま死んでしまうとは、思うんだけど。
lines.label: s105
lines.maoEnglish:
“So―――cold”
Cold was all I could feel.
The pain had gone numb long ago; now it was almost pleasant.
Dogs had left tooth marks all over me, birds had gouged me with their beaks—my body had taken a magnificent beating.
―――Well, yes. I was almost certainly going to die like this.

The pain is numbed; it feels almost comfortable.

----Well, there's no mistake that I'll probably die like this.

「―――――」
　はあ、と大きく息を吐く。
　あごが上がってしまって、ちょうど空を見上げる形になった。
「―――――月」
　夜空には、ただキレイな月がある。
　……なんだろう。
　ひどく懐かしい。
これと似たようなコトを、前にも一度ぐらい、夢に見た気がする。
lines.label: s105
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
I let out a long breath.
My head lolled back, leaving me staring up at the sky.
“―――――The moon”
Nothing occupied the night sky but a beautiful moon.
What was this feeling?
It felt terribly familiar. I thought I had dreamed of something like this once before.

lines.japanese:
「志貴、大丈夫？」
　何事もなかったように歩み寄ってくるアルクェイド。
「……この、バカヤロウ……これで大丈夫だったら、人間じゃない」
　息も絶え絶えで返答した。
　声を出すのも辛いんだから、返事なんかするんじゃなかったかもしれない。
「く――――――あ」
lines.label: s105
lines.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, are you all right?”
Arcueid strolled toward me as though nothing had happened.
“You idiot—if I were all right after this, I wouldn’t be human.”
I forced the answer out between failing breaths.
Speaking hurt so much that perhaps I should not have answered at all.
“Kh――――――ah”

lines.label: s105
lines.maoEnglish:
My consciousness began to break apart.
And then.
Arcueid smacked me smartly on the head and dragged me back to consciousness by force.
lines.mao_english:

lines.japanese:
「……なんの、つもりだ」
「だめよ。
そんな傷で眠っちゃったら、間違いなく生命活動が停止するわ。
眠るのは傷を塞いでからにしなさい」
―――そりゃあまったくの正論だ。
　あんまりに正論すぎて、あたまにきた。
「……アルクェイド。
前から思っていた事、言っていいか」
「ん、なに？」
「―――あんまり無茶いうな、このばか女」
　ばたん、と地面に倒れこんだ。
lines.label: s105
lines.maoEnglish:
“What was that for?”
“No. If you fall asleep with wounds like these, your vital functions will definitely stop. You may sleep after we close them.”
―――She was absolutely right.
So right, in fact, that it made me furious.
“Arcueid. Can I tell you something I’ve been thinking for a while?”
“What is it?”
“Stop demanding the impossible, you stupid woman.”
I toppled flat onto the ground.

"That won't do.

"Hm, what?"
"----Don't say such unreasonable things, you idiot."
I crash onto the ground.

“Shiki, you really are going to die…!”
That was why I was so sleepy.
I’d sleep before I died, then wake up properly in the morning.

　せめて傷口を塞いで、血ぐらい補っておかないと目覚められないわよ……！」
　―――ああ、うるさいな。
　俺は眠るから、やりたかったらすきにしてくれ。
「え、いいのわたしが治しちゃって？
　なんだ、そういうコトなら早く言ってくれれば良かったのに」
　明るい声が聞こえたあと。
　冷たい、今の自分の体より冷たい指先が、いたわるように肌に触れていくのを感じた。
lines.label: s105
lines.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, I told you not to fall asleep! If we don’t at least close your wounds and replace some of your blood, you’ll never wake up…!”
―――God, she was noisy.
I was going to sleep, so if she wanted to do something, she could do as she pleased.
“Oh, I’m allowed to heal you? You should have said so in the first place.”
After that bright reply.
Fingers colder even than my body touched my skin with surprising tenderness.

　冷たい、今の自分の体より冷たい指先が、いたわるように肌に触れていくのを感じた。

「ま、他人の使い魔を受け入れるのはイヤだけど、この際仕方ないかな」
　……なにかを塗られているような感触。
　わけがわからないけれど、
　ただ、ひどく心地いい――
「さすがは原初の海ともいわれた吸血鬼ね。
大元であるネロが消滅しても、使い魔たちは蘇生可能域にまだ残ってる。
……うん、これならわたしが後押しするだけでなんとかなるかな。
　まずこっちに寄生させて―――元気になったら志貴に移せば、と――――」
　指先が、離れていく。

lines.maoEnglish:
“I hate the idea of taking someone else’s familiar into me, but I suppose we don’t have much choice.”
It feels as though she is spreading something over me.
I can’t understand any of it,
only that it feels wonderful――
“He really was a vampire worthy of the name ‘primordial sea.’ Even with their source, Nrvnqsr, destroyed, his familiars remain within their resurrection range. Yes, I should be able to manage this with a little assistance.
First I’ll let them take root here, then move them into Shiki once they’ve recovered――――”
Her fingertips left my skin.

　方向性のない命の種だから、すでに人間として形をもってる志貴の体にすんなり寄生してくれてるでしょう？

―――ああ、眠ってる。

Wait, Shiki, did you fall asleep―――?”
―――Yes, I was asleep.
“I suppose I have no choice. Your house is that mansion at the top of the hill, isn’t it? I’ll find some way to get you home.”
―――Still asleep, I watched nothing but the white moon.

I landed hard on my backside, catching my collapsing body with both hands.
At last, my right hand let go of the knife.

The pain had gone numb long ago; now it was almost pleasant.
Dogs had left tooth marks all over me, birds had gouged me with their beaks—my body had taken a magnificent beating.
―――Well, yes. I was almost certainly going to die like this.

A blue-black crow.

クワア、と鳴き声をあげて、蒼い鴉は一直線に落ちてくる。

「っ――――！」
　逃げようと立ちあがる。
　けれど、体はやっぱり限界だった。
　立ちあがるつもりが、地面に倒れこんでしまう。
　あお向けに倒れこんだせいで、よけいはっきりと蒼い鴉の姿が見えた。

lines.maoEnglish:
With a raucous cry, the crow plunged straight down.
Its sharp beak was aimed to pierce the crown of my skull.
“――――!”
I tried to scramble away.
But my body had truly reached its limit.
Meaning to stand, I only toppled backward.
Landing flat on my back gave me an even clearer view of the descending crow.
It fell toward my face like a bullet—and an instant before impact, something struck with a vicious crack and killed it.

The figure stood atop a streetlamp, looking down at me.
Though I had nearly died, my dazed mind found itself admiring those tall lace-up boots.
The figure said nothing.
Those emotionless eyes had the same keen edge as the moonlight.
They looked like hers.
So very much like Ciel’s.
“…”
My consciousness swayed.
The crow’s long death scream tore through the night.
I quietly closed my eyes.

“Hard.”
Yes, hard.
Whatever pressed against my back was so unforgiving that it snapped me wide awake.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"----Har… d."
Yeah, it's hard.
I feel something hard against my back, and it causes me to wake with a start.
lines.mirror_moon:
"----Har… d."

lines.japanese:
「…………………」
「あれ―――アルクェイド」
　はて、と周りを見渡す。
　ここは公園。
自分はベンチで横になっている。
　公園の時計を見るかぎり、時刻は午前一時すぎ。
　あれから一時間ほどしか経っていない、という事だろうか。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
“Huh—Arcueid?”
I looked around in confusion.
This was a park. I was lying on a bench.
The park clock read a little after one in the morning. Could only an hour have passed?

lines.japanese:
「……………………」
　アルクェイドは、無言で俺を見つめている。
　……というか、睨んでいるような、気もする。
「アル……クェイド……？」
「…………………」
　アルクェイドは答えない。
　原因は不明だけど、どうも彼女はいたくご立腹みたいだ。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
Arcueid stared at me without a word.
In fact, I had the distinct impression she was glaring.
“Arcueid…?”
“…”
She did not answer.
I had no idea why, but she appeared to be in a towering temper.

Arcueid looks at me wordlessly.
…… Or maybe it's more like a glare.
"Ar…… cueid……?"
"……………………"

I don't know why, but she seems really angry.

lines.japanese:
「……よっと」
　とりあえず、ベンチから立ちあがった。
「あ―――傷、塞がってる」
　あれだけボロボロに切り裂かれたっていうのに、体には一つの傷跡さえない。
　痛みも当然のようになくて、まるでネロとの一戦が夢だったみたいだ。
―――けど、あれは夢じゃない。
　と、なると―――これは、もしかして。
「アルクェイド。
おまえまさか、またネロの体を塗りつけたのか……？」
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
“Up we go…”
For the moment, I got to my feet.
“My wounds—they’re closed.”
Though I had been torn to ribbons, not a single scar remained.
The pain was gone as well, as if the battle with Nrvnqsr had been nothing but a dream.
―――But it hadn’t been a dream.
Which meant—could it be?
“Arcueid. Don’t tell me you smeared Nrvnqsr’s flesh all over me again…?”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… There."
For now, I stand up.
"Oh----my wounds are healed."
I was so bloody and cut up, but there isn't a single scar anywhere.
There isn't any pain either, as if my fight with Nrvnqsr was all a dream.
---But, that was no dream.
Then, this---must be…
"Arcueid.
Don't tell me you used another part of Nrvnqsr's body again……?"

lines.japanese:
「いいえ、残念ながらはずれよ。
そのほうが手っ取り早いし、志貴も強くなれたんだけどね。
そもそも志貴がネロを完全に『殺』しちゃったから、ネロの体はもう使えないわ」
「へえ、それじゃあちゃんとあれ以外の方法で治してくれたんだ。
　……すごいな、ほんとに元通りだ。
痛みもないし眩暈もしない。
いったいどんなふうに治したんだ、アルクェイド」
「しらない。
志貴を治したのはわたしじゃないから」
　乱暴に言って、アルクェイドは不機嫌そうに顔をそむけた。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
“No, sorry, wrong answer. That would have been quicker and might have made you stronger too. But you ‘killed’ Nrvnqsr completely, so his body can’t be used anymore.”
“Oh, so you healed me some other way.
That’s incredible. I’m completely back to normal—no pain, no dizziness. How did you do it, Arcueid?”
“I don’t know. I wasn’t the one who healed you.”
Arcueid delivered that answer sharply and turned her face away in a sulk.

lines.label: s106

But if Arcueid hadn’t healed me, who else could have―――

「――――――あ」
　いた。
　もう一人、誰かがいたんだ。
　すんでのところで自分を助けてくれた誰か。
　……シエル先輩に似すぎていた、あの黒い服の女の人。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
“Oh.”
There.
Someone else was there.
Someone who saved me at the last instant.
That woman in black who looked far too much like Ciel.
lines.mao_english:

Someone who helped me.
…… That woman in black garments who resembled Senpai far too much.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「アルクェイド、さっきのヤツは！？」
「……………」
　アルクェイドは不機嫌な顔つきのまま、そっぽを向いて無視なんてしやがる。
「アルクェイド、おい！
　さっきの人はどうしたかって聞いてるんだけど！」
「知らない。
わたし、そんなヤツ見なかった」
　ぷい、と顔を背けてあくまでしらをきるアルクェイド。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, where did that woman go?”
“…”
Arcueid, still wearing that sour expression, turned away and ignored me.
“Arcueid, hey! I’m asking what happened to the woman who was here!”
“I don’t know. I didn’t see anybody.”
She tossed her face aside and persisted in that transparent lie.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid… where is that person from before!?"
"………………"
Still looking displeased, she looks away and ignores me.
"Hey, Arcueid!
I'm asking you what happened to that person from before!"
"I don't know.
I didn't see anyone."
She turns away and pretends not to know anything.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「あのな―――さっき俺を治したのは自分じゃないって言ってただろ。
おまえじゃなかったら、他の誰が俺を助けてくれたっていうんだよ！」
「ああもうっ、知らないったら知らないのっ！」
　あ。
アルクェイドが、逆ギレした。
「だいたいね、どうして志貴があいつなんかのことを気にかけるのよ。
あいつが誰であろうと志貴には関係ないんじゃない？」
「ばっ―――関係なんか、ある。
……暗くてよくわからなかったけど、さっきの人影は、その……知ってる人に、似てた気がするんだ」
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
“You just said you weren’t the one who healed me. If it wasn’t you, then who else saved my life?”
“I said I don’t know!”
Ah. Now Arcueid was furious at me.
“Why do you even care about her? Whoever she is, she has nothing to do with you.”
“Of course she does! It was dark, so I couldn’t see clearly, but that figure looked like someone I know.”

"Hey---you just said you weren't the one who helped me.

"Oh, enough already, I said I don't know, so I don't know!"

"In the first place, why are you so interested in that person?

"Idi---there is something.

「――――そんなのただの偶然よ。
いいからあんなヤツのことは忘れて。
わたしの前であいつの話をしたら、本当に怒るからね」
　ぴしゃりと言いきって、アルクェイドは顔を背けた。
「……本当に怒るって、なんだよそれ」
　怒りたいのはこっちのほうだ。
　俺はただ、さっきの人影のことが知りたいだけなのに。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
“That was only a coincidence. Forget about her. If you mention her in front of me again, I’ll really get angry.”
With that flat declaration, Arcueid turned away.
“What do you mean, ‘really’ angry?”
I was the one who ought to be angry.
All I wanted was to know who that shadowy figure had been.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"----That's just a coincidence.
Just forget about that person.
If you talk about it again in front of me, I'll really get mad."
Ending quickly, she looks away.
"…… Why are you so angry?"
I should be the one getting angry.
I just want to know who that person from before was, that's all.

「当然だろ。
この街ですき放題やってた吸血鬼は倒したんだし、これで俺の責任ってヤツもなくなったんだ。
　俺だってそろそろ家に戻らないと秋葉のヤツになんて叱られるかわからないしな。

「ん―――そうね、言われてみればそうかも。

　うん、とアルクェイドは頷いてくれた。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Fine. I won’t ask anything else. Besides, this is where our relationship ends.”
“What―――?”
“It’s obvious. We defeated the vampire who was running wild through this city, so my share of the responsibility is over.
I need to get home before Akiha decides on some horrible punishment. This seems like the right time to part ways, don’t you think, Arcueid?”
“Mm, I suppose you’re right. And it has gotten very late.”
Arcueid nodded in agreement.

“Good.”
Satisfied, I nodded as well.
I nodded, satisfied—or tried to be.
Something remained lodged deep inside me.
A lingering regret at the thought of leaving her here and never seeing her again.
“…”
Ridiculous.
She was a vampire, and I was an ordinary human being.
If we stayed involved any longer, something truly irreversible would happen.

lines.maoEnglish:
“Goodbye, Arcueid.”
I raised one hand and began to walk away.
“I mean… some terrible things happened, but it was fun too, in its way. So—take care of yourself.”
“You’re right. It’s late tonight, so you should go home.”
“Good night. See you again, Shiki!”
“…”
I had the odd feeling she had just said something very strange.

lines.maoEnglish:
I almost called after her retreating back that this was the last time, but stopped myself.
“She has plenty of problems, but she is interesting.”
I muttered it as if making excuses to myself.
Yet it was true.
So, once in a while.
Seeing her once more by some accident might not be such a bad thing.

　疲れきった体をベッドに沈ませて、安らかな眠りに落ちていった。

Back in my room, I stretched luxuriously.
It was over.
At last, I could truly believe that the strange events of the past three days had ended.
“Time for bed.”
I sank my exhausted body into the mattress and drifted toward peaceful sleep.

Body and mind were exhausted, yet that shadowy figure kept me awake.

lines.japanese: 『不老不死』。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish: “Ageless Immortality.”
lines.mao_english: “Ageless Immortality.”
lines.mirrorMoon: "Immortality".
lines.mirror_moon: "Immortality".

lines.japanese:
その言葉が真実無二ならば、それは永遠を定義するものの一つとなろう。
　だが現実に、その域に達しているモノはいない。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
If those words could be made absolutely true, they would offer one possible definition of eternity.
Yet nothing in reality has ever attained such a state.
lines.mao_english:
If those words could be made absolutely true, they would offer one possible definition of eternity.
Yet nothing in reality has ever attained such a state.
lines.mirrorMoon:
If those words are to be a grand reality, it would be one of the things which would define eternity.
But in reality, nothing in existence has reached that level.
lines.mirror_moon:
If those words are to be a grand reality, it would be one of the things which would define eternity.

lines.japanese:
例えば、伝承に時折顔を出す吸血鬼の類としても、不老不死ではありえない。
　彼らは所詮、他者からなにかを略奪しなければ存在していられない欠陥品だ。
　しかもその補充品が同種―――この場合、大半が人間という事になる―――でしかありえない、という点において、まったく汎用性というものがない。
　超越種、などと謳ってはいるが、それは進化ではなく退化であろう。
　単一種としての永久機関でなければ、それは永遠とは呼べまい。
　他者に依存しなければ不老でいられぬ命など、不老不死を名乗るもおこがましい。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
Even the vampires who surface now and again in legend cannot possess ageless immortality.
They are defective things, unable to exist unless they plunder something from others.
Worse, what replenishes them must come from their own kind—which, in most cases, means human beings; they possess no adaptability whatsoever.
They may proclaim themselves a transcendent species, but theirs is not evolution, only regression.
Unless a species forms a perpetual motion machine unto itself, it cannot be called eternal.
A life that depends upon others to remain ageless has no right to claim immortality.
lines.mao_english:

They are defective things, unable to exist unless they plunder something from others.
Worse, what replenishes them must come from their own kind—which, in most cases, means human beings; they possess no adaptability whatsoever.
They may proclaim themselves a transcendent species, but theirs is not evolution, only regression.
Unless a species forms a perpetual motion machine unto itself, it cannot be called eternal.
A life that depends upon others to remain ageless has no right to claim immortality.
lines.mirrorMoon:
For example, those vampires occasionally spoken of in legends are not immortal.
After all, they are defective because they require stealing from others to exist.
Furthermore, the fact that their supplemental parts have to be of the same species---in this case, generally referring to humans----means that they are not versatile at all.
They call themselves the transcendent race, but that is not evolution, it is degeneration.
That which cannot function independently in perpetuity cannot be called eternal.
It is presumptuous to call something immortal if it depends on others to halt its aging.

lines.japanese:
単一種としての永久機関には、すでに完璧に近い生物が存在する。
　自らを食料とし、それを糧に繁殖する。
寿命などというものもない。
古くなった細胞は栄養源として食料になり、新しい細胞を生み出し続ける。
　群体と呼ばれるもの。
例えばクラゲ。
　しかし、それは知性という余分な機能を持たないが故の永久機関だ。
　知性を持たないでいいというのなら、それは死をもって永遠とする所となんら変わりはない。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:
Creatures already exist that approach perfection as self-sustaining perpetual motion machines.
They consume themselves and reproduce from what they consume. They have no lifespan. Old cells become nourishment, while new cells are born without end.
Colonial organisms. Jellyfish, for example.
Yet such creatures function eternally only because they lack the superfluous faculty called intelligence.
If intelligence may be discarded, that is no different from seeking eternity in death.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:

It feeds on itself and multiplies.
It has no such thing as a lifespan.
Old cells become food as nutrients and new cells are produced from it.
Such as a jellyfish.
However, it is perpetual only because it has no intelligence.
If having no intelligence is fine, then it is no different from gaining eternity by death.

The passage of ages will erode the body and wear all suppleness from the mind.

　手垢のついた不老不死になど、未練はない。
　個人に固執するのならば永遠はありえまい。
　一人の人間として生き続ける不老不死より。
　私は、永遠に存在し続ける無限を選んだ。

I have no attachment to that shopworn dream of deathlessness.
So long as one clings to the individual, eternity is impossible.
Rather than an immortality lived as one human being.
I chose an infinity that would continue to exist for all eternity.

I have no attachment to stained immortality.

……なるほど、たしかにそれは私とは違うアプローチだ。
しかしな、その方法では人間が絶滅した場合、君は永遠ではなくならないか？
　君の手段には、どうしても自分以外の生まれていない胎児が必要となるではないか。
lines.label: s106
lines.maoEnglish:

You invariably require the unborn child of another human being.
lines.mao_english:

Your method always requires an unborn child other than yourself.

I cannot reduce everything to nothingness myself. And so, until then, I continue to live.
Admittedly. I have lately discovered one other pleasure.”

The last time I was here, I was too consumed by Arcueid herself to notice the furnishings, but now it looks remarkably like an ordinary person’s room.
“She even gets the newspaper. What is she?”
Grumbling, I lay Arcueid on the bed.

I lower myself to the floor and take a deep breath.
It will soon be six in the morning.
Daylight is growing beyond the windows, though the sky is thick with clouds.
“……Right.
I should close the curtains.”
I force my sluggish body upright, draw every curtain in the room, and sit on the floor again.

lines.label: s94
lines.maoEnglish:
Thud.
My knees give out halfway down, and I crumple to the floor.
“Huh. Guess I’m tired too.”
Pathetic as it is, I cannot get back up.
I spent all last night talking with Arcueid, and I have gone more than a day without a proper meal.
Worse, even the glasses cannot stop the headache, and every nerve in my brain has been throwing up its hands for a while now.

　だからきっと大丈夫。
誰がなんていったって、志貴本人がそうじゃないって言いきったって―――志貴は、まだそっち側の世界にいられるよ」
「な―――――」
　……言葉がない。
　よくもまあ―――自分を殺した相手に対して、こんな台詞を笑顔で言えるんだろう、コイツは。

Honest people who can apologize even to a vampire, for instance.
So I know you’ll be all right. No matter what anyone says—even if you yourself deny it—you can still remain on that side of the world.”
“Wh……”
I have no words.
How can she smile and say something like that to the person who killed her?

“Damn—I suppose I’m still not ready for that.”
I look.
The white fabric over her stomach is slowly blooming red.

I look around the room.
Just as I thought, there is no first-aid kit or anything else that might be useful for treating her.

　う、うん、お金には不自由してないけど、それがなによ」

手当てに必要な物を買いこんでくるから。
　……おまえに効果があるかどうかはわからないけど、とりあえず怪我をした人間が必要とする手当てぐらいはしないといけない」
「いいけど、無駄かもしれないよ？」
「―――無駄でもやるんだ。

lines.label: s94
lines.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, you said you were rich, didn’t you?”
“What? Y-yes, I never have trouble with money, but why?”
“Hand it over. I’m going to buy supplies. I don’t know whether human treatment will help you, but at the very least we have to do what we would for an injured person.”
“All right, but it may be pointless.”
“Then I’ll do it even if it is. I’m not leaving you like this.”

“Enough—give me the money. Lie there and keep quiet. But don’t fall asleep. Even if you lie down, stay awake.”

lines.japanese:
「無茶だけどやるのっ。
眠ると体の機能が低下するって聞いた事があるんだ。
　傷が塞がっていない状態で眠ると身体の抵抗力が落ちてしまって、傷がますます悪化するっていうコトだと思う。
　睡眠が回復してくれるのは疲れだけで、傷や病気は治してくれないだろ。
だから、とりあえず手当てをするまでは眠らないようにするんだ」
「―――へえ。
うん、それってその通りよ志貴」
　アルクェイドは嬉しそうに笑う。
　……やっぱりこいつの思考回路は理解しがたい。
lines.label: s94
lines.maoEnglish:
“Unreasonable or not, you’re doing it. I’ve heard that your body’s functions slow down while you sleep.
If you sleep before a wound closes, your resistance must weaken and make the injury even worse.
Sleep only cures exhaustion; it doesn’t heal wounds or diseases. So stay awake until I’ve treated you.”
“Oh. Yes, that’s exactly right, Shiki.”
Arcueid smiles delightedly.
Her thought process remains beyond comprehension.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"It's absurd but do it.
I've heard your bodily functions weaken when you sleep.
I think if you sleep with open wounds, your immune system will get weak and your wound will get even worse.
Sleeping will only help your tiredness, not heal your wound.
So for now, at least don't sleep until I get back."
"----Really?
Okay, I'll do that Shiki."
Arcueid smiles happily.
…… As expected, Arcueid's thought process is completely a mystery.

“Food.”
The table holds something that could generously be called a meal, more accurately called grub, and most accurately called a food-like substance.
So this is why Arcueid was in the kitchen.

Then again, my entire knowledge of first aid amounts to gauze for covering a wound, bandages to hold it in place, and perhaps painkillers.
Still, anything must be better than nothing.
Even the smallest thing, if it exists, is more than zero.
Clinging to that belief, I buy everything I can think of.

「でも色々と話をしてたじゃないか」
「だからって知り合いっていうのは早計ね。

　古参の吸血鬼の一人なのに、城も領地も持たないでさまよってる変わり者。
　教会の連中からはなんでかカオスっていう二つ名をつけられているんだけど」
lines.label: s94
lines.maoEnglish:
“But the two of you talked about all sorts of things.”
“That hardly makes us acquaintances.
Nrvnqsr is a reasonably famous vampire, and my own name is well known among their kind, so introductions were unnecessary.
Naturally, the older a vampire becomes and the stranger his abilities, the farther his name spreads.
Nrvnqsr is exceptional even among them.
He is one of the ancient vampires, yet an eccentric wanderer with neither castle nor territory.
For some reason, the Church gave him the epithet Chaos.”

「もうっ。
志貴も見たでしょう、あいつの体の中身を。
前に話したと思うけど、長く生きた吸血鬼ほど自分の肉体が破損すると中々修復できなくなるの。
　すでに何百年と存在してきた器を修復するには、人間ぐらいの命ではレベルが足りない。
　だから単純に、生命としてより優れた素材をもつ猛獣や魔獣をとりこんで、自分の肉体として作り変える。
　……ネロは吸血鬼の中でも最古参の一人らしいから、体の代わりにして獲りこんでいるケモノの数が桁違いに多いのかも」

lines.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, Shiki. You saw what was inside him. I think I explained before: the longer a vampire lives, the harder it becomes to repair damage to the body.
An ordinary human life does not provide material of a high enough order to restore a vessel that has existed for centuries.
So they absorb beasts and Demonic Beasts—creatures with superior vitality—and remake them into their own flesh.
Nrvnqsr is said to be among the oldest vampires, so perhaps the number of beasts he has absorbed as substitutes for his body is simply beyond comparison.”

“So even those black dogs were parts of Nrvnqsr’s body?”
“Yes, but a human vessel has limits. At most, it should be able to control around thirty animals as its own body.
If it absorbed even one member of the Phantasmal Species—the creatures classed as Demonic Beasts or Phantasmal Beasts—its capacity would overflow.
So Nrvnqsr’s familiars are probably all species that still exist today.
In that sense, we may have been lucky.”
I did not understand that last part, but apparently there may be thirty of those black dogs.

そもそも約束は一晩眠りの番をするだけだっただろ。
これ以上、俺はあんな怪物には関われない」
「あ、それは無理じゃないかな。
志貴はネロと会っちゃったもの。
わたしと一緒にいなくても、ネロは志貴のことを放っておかないと思う」
　他人事のようにあっさりと言いきるアルクェイド。
lines.label: s96
lines.maoEnglish:
“I’m glad you think so highly of me, but I can’t do it. Our agreement was only that I would watch over you for one night. I can’t involve myself any further with that monster.”
“I don’t think that’s possible. You’ve already met Nrvnqsr. Even if you leave me, I doubt he’ll leave you alone.”
Arcueid delivered the verdict with all the concern of a disinterested bystander.

lines.maoEnglish:
“What—?”
The cry escaped me, and in the same instant I knew she was right.
Nrvnqsr was a vampire who roamed the city killing people. Since he had seen my face, there was no chance a murderer like that would simply forget me.

lines.label: s96
lines.maoEnglish:
“Though I might reach you before Nrvnqsr does. He can’t move during the day while I’m standing right in front of you, which gives me an overwhelming advantage.”
“What exactly is that supposed to mean?”
“It means that if you intend to run away, perhaps I’ll simply kill you here.”
Arcueid smiled as she said it, leaving me no way to tell whether she was joking.

Fortunately, that hardened my resolve a little.

“……”

“What—?”
“You said the question was how to act. It isn’t. The question is how to kill him.”
“That’s true, but—”

My eyes locked on the newscaster inside the television screen.

Missing?

“Because the sun came up, I imagine. It was already daylight when we left the hotel. Vampires can’t function properly while the sun is up.”
Arcueid said this as though it had nothing to do with her, despite supposedly being a vampire herself.

――――What?
Her arms and legs were finally moving properly—did that mean—
“Wait. Arcueid, are you saying you could barely move until now?”

She had not told me.

I remembered Arcueid last night when that azure crow arrived, biting her lip in frustration.
She had truly hated her own helplessness—wanting to move and being unable to.

lines.maoEnglish:
“I see. Even if it's gradual, I'm glad you're starting to feel better.”
A breath of genuine relief escaped me.
“Well, look at you, Shiki. Not long ago you were calling me a monster, and now you're worried about me.”
“Idiot. I still think you're a monster. That has nothing to do with this—when someone saves you, the least you can do is be grateful.”
“What? I saved you?”
Arcueid’s eyes widened in surprise.
Apparently she had no awareness of having done anything of the kind.

“Th-th-th—”
“What’s with all the th-th-th-ing and that frightening face? If you have something to say, say it. Surely you and I are past the point of holding back.”

lines.label: s98
lines.maoEnglish:
“You thought I was some deranged serial killer, and that's why you told me to be your shield and stand watch against monsters!
What an unbelievable mistake. So that was why you had such absurd faith in me.
Listen, because I'm only saying this once: I am not a murderer or a homicidal maniac.
You were—the first person I ever killed.”
Arcueid stared at me with her mouth hanging open.
Damn it, apparently that was the last thing she had expected to hear.

“You’re lying. You were that good, and it was your first time, Shiki?”
“It was. I may have these strange eyes, but I’ve still tried to live a decent life. Not once have I ever wanted to use these ‘lines’ to kill anyone.”
“Then why did you kill a complete stranger?”
“I don't know. The moment I saw you in town, I couldn't get you out of my mind—and the next thing I knew, I had cut you into pieces—”

lines.maoEnglish:
Here, in this room.
for no reason, with no purpose.
“I see.”
Of course.
I had no right to be angry with Arcueid.
It made no difference that she was alive now, or that she wasn’t human.
I had killed her with my own hands.
“Why have you suddenly gone quiet again? What did you mean by 'I see,' Shiki?”
“I mean that I have to say I'm sorry.”

I truly was sick in the head.
Of course Arcueid had mistaken me for a murderer.
I couldn’t even understand the impulse that had seized me then.

「―――それはそうだけど。
おまえを殺したっていう事実だけは、決して、変わらないじゃないか」
　そう。

「それは当然よ。

lines.label: s98
lines.maoEnglish:
“And I don’t think you need to be punished.
By chance, the person you wanted to kill was me, and unfortunately, you possessed the most perfect talent for murder imaginable.
But conveniently enough, I was a vampire, so nobody died. There’s no reason for you to torment yourself over it.
You don’t need to worry about the morals of human society, either.
As things stand, only two people in this world have any right to condemn you: me, the victim, and you yourself, the other person directly involved.”
“Maybe so. But nothing can ever change the fact that I killed you.”
Exactly.
There might be no punishment, but the sin itself would never disappear.
“Naturally. I’m still holding a grudge, so I would be annoyed if you forgot that easily.
But listen, Shiki. If you understand what you did and regret it for the rest of your life, isn’t that enough?”
――But that was sophistry.
“Shiki. Some people truly cannot sell their souls to the devil, no matter how bitterly they hate the world. Honest fools who can apologize even to a vampire, for instance.
“So you’ll be all right. Whatever anyone says—even if you yourself insist otherwise—you can still remain on the human side of the world.”
“……”
I had no answer.
How could she smile and say something like that to the man who had murdered her?

“Honestly, Shiki. You saw what was inside him. I think I explained before: the longer a vampire lives, the harder it becomes to repair damage to the body.

lines.japanese:
「間違わないでネロ。
現存している死徒は二十七祖じゃなくて二十八でしょう。
貴方たちは『蛇』を同胞と認めていないの？」
「無論だ。
ヤツの思想は我々とは大きく異なる。
ヤツは吸血種である意味をもたない吸血種だ。
よって、多くの死徒はアレを同胞と認めていない」
lines.label: s99
lines.maoEnglish:
“Don’t be mistaken, Nrvnqsr. There aren’t twenty-seven Dead Apostle Ancestors left in the world, but twenty-eight. Do none of you acknowledge the Serpent as one of your own?”
“Of course not. His ideals differ fundamentally from ours. He belongs to the vampiric species, yet his existence as such has no meaning. Most Dead Apostles therefore refuse to recognize him as a compatriot.”

lines.japanese:
「真逆。
異端は孤立するが故に異端だ。
群から外れているからといって、異端同士が分かり合える道理はない」
「そう？
　わたしを追ってこんな国までやってくるあたり、貴方たちは似ていると思うけどね」
「ほざくな。
ならば貴様こそ酔狂がすぎよう。
　現存する死徒たちを処刑するはずの貴様が、なぜ執拗にアカシャの蛇を追う。
『蛇』は真祖の姫君が固執するほどの毒ではありえまい」
lines.label: s99
lines.maoEnglish:
“Quite the contrary. A heretic is a heretic precisely because he stands alone. Exile from the herd gives two outcasts no cause to understand one another.”
“Is that so? You both pursued me all the way to this country, which seems rather similar to me.”
“Enough. By that measure, your own caprice is far more extravagant.
You exist to execute the surviving Dead Apostles, so why pursue the Serpent of Akasha with such tenacity? The Serpent cannot be venom potent enough to merit the obsession of the Princess of the True Ancestors.”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Wrong.
Heresy is isolated therefore it is heresy.
Just because we both are separated from the flock doesn't mean we comprehend one another."
"Really?
Coming as far as this country to pursue me, I think you guys are similar."
"Do not be ridiculous.
You are the capricious one.
Your purpose is to execute Dead Apostles, so why do you persistently pursue the Serpent of Akasha?
The 'Serpent's' poison is not something the Princess of the True Ancestors should be persistent about."
